checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Forehead Cards", twelve category pills each with a count, and an enabled "Start round" button.
Choosing "None" disables "Start round" and shows "Pick at least one category to start."
Start round shows a 3-2-1 countdown, then a card name, a category tag and a timer starting at the chosen round length.
During play, ArrowRight marks Correct, ArrowLeft marks Pass and Space pauses; End round shows the round summary listing each card.
In the summary, activating a card toggles it between Correct and Passed.
Tapping the right half of the play screen marks the card Correct.
Team mode offers "Next team" after a round and shows a team scoreboard with the entered team names.
A custom deck can be created from one entry per line (blank lines and repeats skipped), deleted, and restored with Undo.
The round length and selected categories survive a reload.
The Print tab lays out 18 cards on the first sheet and offers a Print button.
